mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM ed2k_download_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT count(*) FROM ed2k_download_task WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND desired_state = 'ACTIVE' AND task_state NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'ERROR')
SELECT count(*) FROM ed2k_download_task WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted = 0 AND desired_state = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT * FROM ed2k_download_task WHERE resource_id = #{resourceId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ed2k_download_task ( task_uuid, user_id, resource_id, requested_name, desired_state, task_state, progress_bytes, revision, error_code, error_message, completed_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{task.taskUuid}, #{task.userId}, #{task.resourceId}, #{task.requestedName}, #{task.desiredState}, #{task.taskState}, #{task.progressBytes}, #{task.revision}, #{task.errorCode}, #{task.errorMessage}, #{task.completedAt}, #{task.createdAt}, #{task.updatedAt}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE ed2k_download_task SET desired_state = #{desiredState}, task_state = #{taskState}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_uuid = #{taskUuid} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision}

UPDATE ed2k_download_task SET task_state = #{taskState}, progress_bytes = #{progressBytes}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{taskId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND revision = #{expectedRevision}
